steps.stdout:
Usage:
lobster [ OPTIONS ] [ FILE ] [ -- ARGS ]
Compile & run FILE, or omit FILE to load default.lpak
--help                  This help.
--cpp                   Compile to C++ code, don't run (see implementation.md!).
--pak                   Generate lpak file, don't run.
--rpak                  Generate lpak file, include runnable code, don't run.
--import RELDIR         Additional dir (relative to FILE) to load imports from
--main MAIN             if present, run this main program file after compiling FILE.
--parsedump             Also dump parse tree.
--verbose               Output additional informational text.
--debug                 Output compiler internal logging.
--silent                Only output errors.
--full-error            Output full compile time stack traces, also for warnings.
--runtime-no-asserts    Compile with asserts off.
--runtime-asserts       Compile with asserts on (default).
--runtime-stack-traces  Asserts on + code locations + stack traces.
--runtime-debug         Also minimize inlining.
--runtime-debug-dump    Also create debug dumps.
--runtime-debugger      Also break into debugger on error.
--runtime-debugger-dump Also create dump + break into debugger on error.
--invert-stacktraces    Shows stacktraces most recent call last.
--noconsole             Close console window (Windows).
--gen-builtins-html     Write builtin commands help file.
--gen-builtins-names    Write builtin commands - just names.
--non-interactive-test [N] Quit after N frames (default 1).
--background            Open the window behind all others, without taking focus.
--tcc-out               Output tcc .o file instead of running.
--mir [N]               JIT with MIR instead of libtcc, optionally at
                        optimization level N (0..3, default 2).
--c-out                 Output the C the JIT backend would compile, don't run.
--no-crash-dialog       Exit silently on a crash rather than popping up a dialog.
--wait                  Wait for input before exiting.
--query QUERY_ARGS      Queries about definitions in the program being compiled.
--errors N              Output up to N errors (default 10).
